question: M2 time to hold less of the counters and working words
number: Bound used: 64 registers x 32 B = 2,048 B (0.21 percent of the 966,272 B). Needed by our own count: 25 simultaneously live batch values (exact liveness, U81 regs.py) + 7 lane indices + 7 birth counters + about 8 counters and limits = 47 words = 1,504 B. The working words are state, not a table, so they cannot be recomputed instead of held; shrinking the bound to 1,504 B frees 544 B and changes no score.
notes: universe cell blake3-r3|MEM.CNT|MEM|M2. The 47-word list is our own itemisation; the entry states only 'below 2,048 B'.
